LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.MotorShop.Tracking
LocaleResource.Value: Builds the tracking link from a URL template per carrier and shows carrier, tracking number and status on the customer order details page. No courier API.

LocaleResource.Name: Carriers.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: One carrier per line: "Carrier name | https://.../{0}". {0} is replaced by the tracking number. Only https URLs are accepted. Lines starting with # are ignored.

LocaleResource.Name: DefaultCarrier.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Used when a shipment has no carrier name. Must match a name in the list above.

LocaleResource.Name: DefaultCarrierUnknown
LocaleResource.Value: The default carrier is not one of the valid carriers.

LocaleResource.Name: ShowOnOrderDetails.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Shows carrier, tracking number, tracking link and status on the customer order details page.

LocaleResource.Name: NoCarriers
LocaleResource.Value: No carrier configured yet. No tracking link is generated.

LocaleResource.Name: InvalidLines
LocaleResource.Value: Ignored lines (no "|", no {0}, not https or duplicate name):

LocaleResource.Name: AdminInstruction
LocaleResource.Value: When a shipment gets a tracking number, the tracking link is built from the carrier's template and stored in the shipment's "Tracking URL". A URL entered manually is never replaced. The carrier is read from the "Carrier" field of the shipment edit page.

LocaleResource.Name: TurkishTemplates.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Adds Turkish subject and body to the "shipment sent" and "shipment delivered" e-mails. Templates that already have Turkish text are not changed.
